c35c2a6a-f989-48d0-b16c-ac2ab8048c4f.en: How many drinks of alcohol have you usually had on the days when you drank alcohol? One drink is 1 bottle of medium-strength beer or cider, 1 glass (12 cl) of wine or a restaurant measure (4 cl) of spirits.
